calculation.description: Cross-sectional contrarian signal: invert the 60-day return normalized by 20-day realized daily volatility. Higher values favor assets with weaker risk-adjusted trailing performance. All inputs are lagged at decision time.

validation.regime_notes: Positive admission IC/ICIR is obtained after inversion. The raw risk-adjusted momentum signal is negative across the tested sample, indicating reversal behavior. Online/recent 2028-07-12 onward and 2029-01-01 onward subsamples remain positive after inversion (IC 0.12749/0.11557 and 0.08727 respectively). Small 15-asset cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
